request.style: English, choral, male solo with SATB choir, pipe organ, harp, timpani, French horn, solemn and majestic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Who says of Cyrus, He is my shepherd
He will accomplish all that I please
Who says of Jerusalem, It shall be rebuilt
And of the temple, Its foundation shall be laid

[Verse]
This is what the LORD says to his anointed
To Cyrus, whose right hand I have grasped
To subdue nations before him and strip kings
Of their armor, to open doors before him

[Verse]
I will go before you and level the mountains
I will shatter doors of bronze and cut through bars
I will give you treasures of darkness hidden
So that you may know that I am the LORD

[Verse]
For the sake of my servant Jacob
Of Israel my chosen, I have called you by name
I have given you a title of honor
Though you do not know me, I am the LORD

[Verse]
In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia
The LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus
He sent a proclamation throughout his kingdom
To build the house of the LORD in Jerusalem

[Outro]
I am the LORD, and there is no other
